manifest.name: Auto-Save Indicator
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: Flashes a 'Saved' badge in the header whenever the store is persisted. Demonstrates ctx.api.middleware ('card.save') and ctx.api.ui.inject.

css:
.plugin-save-indicator { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; margin-left: 8px; font-size: 12px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); align-self: center; }
.plugin-save-indicator.visible { opacity: 1; }
